content: Raw window.localStorage inside a Capacitor WebView is NOT fully durable: Android System WebView storage can be evicted under storage pressure, idle/maintenance sweeps, or 'clear storage' actions, and WKWebView-vs-UIWebView migrations have historically dropped localStorage entirely. Capacitor's official guidance is to use the @capacitor/preferences plugin (backed by native UserDefaults on iOS / SharedPreferences on Android) for anything that must survive reliably, rather than relying on localStorage alone.
